verdict.rationale: Better Auth markets 'Auth for AI agents. MCP auth, token exchange, and agent delegation,' and documents an API Key plugin for creating, managing, and verifying keys with custom expiration, usage counts, and rate limits. It also has an MCP plugin that acts as an OAuth authorization server for MCP clients. That supports separate non-human credentials, but the evidence never documents a first-class per-agent identity, narrowly scoped permissions on those credentials, or instant revocation; the agent-delegation claim is a one-line homepage mention. Missing for 10: documented per-agent machine identity model, permission scoping on API keys or agent tokens, explicit instant revocation of agent credentials, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
